composeFile:
services:
  app:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: ${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://zibonsathi:***@db:5432/zibonsathi}
      NEXTAUTH_SECRET: ${NEXTAUTH_SECRET}
      NEXTAUTH_URL: ${NEXTAUTH_URL:-http://localhost:3000}
      RESEND_API_KEY: ${RESEND_API_KEY}
      EMAIL_FROM: ${EMAIL_FROM:-noreply@zibonsathi.com}
      NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL: ${NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL:-http://localhost:3000}
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - zibonsathi_net
    restart: unless-stopped

  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: zibonsathi
      POSTGRES_USER: zibonsathi
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: zibonsathi
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U zibonsathi -d zibonsathi"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    networks:
      - zibonsathi_net
    restart: unless-stopped

networks:
  zibonsathi_net:
    driver: bridge

volumes:
  postgres_data:
